description: Svelte builds interactive pages from small component files. Its compiler prepares those files for the browser. Learn values, buttons and lists with Svelte 5 runes, one small example at a time. Use a Svelte 5 project. Save a single example as App.svelte unless file names say otherwise. The Svelte compiler is required; these snippets do not run as plain HTML or JavaScript.
versionNote: Uses Svelte 5 runes, event properties and snippet children.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to start count at 4 and click twice
Learn to add a third book with id 3
Learn to change the supplied paragraph to another reminder
learningObjectives: Learn to start count at 4 and click twice
